scope: Conservative static attribution of direct Python SQL execution sites to source-registered Gateway route handlers and the existing supervisor worker operation graphs. Gateway route roots are collected from the Gateway app's local import closure; this does not prove every dynamically registered route is mounted. Worker roots are allowlisted modules/handlers, not proof of a live schedule or event. A site without a static path may be dynamic, callback-driven, imported, CLI-driven, or otherwise unresolved; it is not evidence that a site is dead. Relation names remain heuristic candidates. This report contains no SQL text, parameter values, secrets, live role grants, tenant policy, or ACL authorization and must not be used by itself to revoke privileges.

standard_api.startup_check: generic non-owner/non-privileged current_user==session_user; no API-role identity assertion
standard_api.credential_scope: shared kokonut_runtime login for Gateway domain queries and migration-749 scheduler definition actions (OIDC-capability-gated and audited); OIDC session/capability and ClickHouse outbox actions use the separate credentials listed below; API/general-worker identity separation remains open
standard_api.notification_provider_environment: ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is cleared after deriving a non-secret configured flag; ALERT_SMTP_USER/PASSWORD are explicitly blanked; non-secret SMTP routing fields may remain

api_route_specific_database_identities.purpose: OIDC session operations and global capability checks through bounded functions; location-scope reads still use the shared runtime connection
api_route_specific_database_identities.child_environment: explicit operator_auth allowlist on the API child only

api_route_specific_database_identities.purpose: global-capability-gated dead-letter reads and transitions through bounded functions
api_route_specific_database_identities.child_environment: explicit clickhouse_outbox_operator allowlist on the API child only
api_route_specific_database_identities.activation: credential is optional and absent by default; runtime-role bootstrap enables the login only when configured

standard_general_worker.database_login: kokonut_runtime via PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD from docker-compose.kernel-standard.yml and docker-compose.kernel-runtime-role.yml
standard_general_worker.startup_check: same generic non-owner/non-privileged check as API; no worker-role identity assertion
standard_general_worker.child_filter: worker_subprocess_environment filters named KOKONUT_<WORKER> secrets per exact operation allowlists; isolated children additionally remove shared PG_* and global provider secrets
standard_general_worker.notification_provider_environment: worker receives ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL and ALERT_SMTP_USER/PASSWORD; these non-KOKONUT variables survive child filtering so the delivery child can use them

default_on_children.name: scheduler
default_on_children.enabled_by: KOKONUT_FEATURE_SCHEDULER defaults true in services/core/features.py; Standard Compose does not override it
default_on_children.activation_limit: source-allowlisted modules do not prove a persisted task is active; live schedule state is unassessed

default_on_children.name: event_bus_dispatch
default_on_children.capability_enabled_by: KOKONUT_FEATURE_EVENT_BUS defaults true in Standard Compose
default_on_children.worker_enabled_by: KOKONUT_FEATURE_ISOLATED_EVENT_DISPATCH defaults false; dispatcher uses its migration-648 dedicated login when enabled
default_on_children.database_activity_when_isolation_is_off: paused by services.events.cli without opening the shared database
default_on_children.activation_limit: handler allowlist does not prove registered event traffic or runtime event state

default_on_children.name: notification_delivery
default_on_children.capability_enabled_by: KOKONUT_FEATURE_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY defaults to KOKONUT_FEATURE_EVENT_BUS (true) in Standard Compose
default_on_children.worker_enabled_by: KOKONUT_FEATURE_ISOLATED_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY defaults false; delivery uses its migration-647 dedicated login when enabled
default_on_children.database_activity_when_isolation_is_off: paused by services.events.cli without opening the shared database
default_on_children.activation_limit: a configured provider and isolated database identity are required; a supervised child does not prove successful delivery

isolated_mode_defaults.meaning: Dedicated worker logins/functions are opt-in per operation; source availability is not evidence that an isolated path is active.

role_bootstrap.purpose: provisions shared kokonut_runtime and dedicated operation logins
role_bootstrap.initial_runtime_compatibility_grant: existing public table/sequence DML compatibility grants are not removed by later reprovisioning; exact relation ACLs require separate cohort review
